name: observe_domain
required_work: Collect actors, jobs, harmed parties, workflows, commands, events, policies, documents, source occurrences, decisions, failures, time and authority from real cases.

name: build_language
required_work: Define terms in examples and counterexamples; record homonyms, synonyms, competing definitions and unresolved language.

name: discover_models
required_work: Cluster rules that form internally coherent models; identify contradictions that cannot coexist without translation.

name: draw_contexts
required_work: Name each model applicability boundary and its owner; state inside, outside, negative mission and boundary falsifiers.

name: map_contexts
required_work: Record every contact, influence direction, translation, ACL, published language, shared kernel or explicit separation.

name: model_tactically
required_work: Within each context derive entities, values, aggregates, invariants, services, commands, events, refusals, state, time and concurrency.

name: derive_library_seams
required_work: Use conceptual contours, closure of operations, change axes, algorithm replaceability and effect boundaries to define reusable contracts.

name: derive_products_independently
required_work: Starting from users and outcomes, test adoption, lifecycle, operation, economics, interface, evidence and exit without assuming one product per context.

name: map_products_to_models
required_work: Connect products to owned and imported contexts, capabilities and libraries; preserve every semantic and authority owner.

name: falsify
required_work: Run split/merge, negative twins, unrelated verticals, provider substitution, failure scenarios and semantic-diff tests.

name: implement_and_qualify
required_work: Encode types and laws, build at least two independent implementations, execute conformance and qualify exact provider editions.

name: anneal
required_work: Use production change, incidents, domain-expert correction and new evidence to split, merge, rehome or retire boundaries.
